definitions.short: Kemosh , the god of the Moabites
definitions.full: H3645. Kemosh or Kemish כְּמוֺשׁ proper name, of a divinity Chemosh ( כמש MI 3. 5. 9. 12. 13. 14. 18. 19. 32. 23 also כמש עשתר Jer 1:17 and proper name, masculine כמשמלך 1:1 ; Assyrian Kammusunadbi, a king of Moab Schr COT i, 281 ; = KAT 2, 288 ; compare further Bae Rel 13 f. 238, 256 Nö ZMG 1888, 471 ; ᵐ5 Ξαμώς ); — god of the Moabites to whom Solomon erected a high place 1Kin 11:7 , 33 ; 2Kin 23:13 ; Jer 48:7 (Kt כמישׁ ), 48:13 . Moab is ׳עַםכֿ Num 21:29 (ode) people of Chemosh , and Moabites his sons and daughters, compare Jer 48:46 . He is said to be also the God of the Ammonites Judg 11:25 (probably an error Bae Rel 15 GFM). כמז (√ of following; meaning dubious; Arabic is bunch, heap ). כמישׁ Jer 48:7 Kt, see כְּמוֺשׁ . above כמן (√ of following (si vera l); perhaps be hidden ; compare Aramaic כְּמַן , , lie in ambush ; Arabic id. is denominative from loan-word according to Frä 243 ).
